definitions.gloss: to visit a shrine or temple to worship; to pay one's respects at a sacred place
definitions.explanation: To go to a Shinto shrine or Buddhist temple for the purpose of prayer, worship, or paying respects. A central cultural practice in Japanese life.

examples.japanese: {初詣|はつもうで}で⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{参拝|さんぱい}した。
examples.english: I visited the shrine for the New Year's first worship.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧{近|ちか}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{参拝|さんぱい}する⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{日課|にっか}→日課：00317_nikka⟧だ。
examples.english: It's my daily routine to visit the nearby temple every morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れ→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧、⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧や⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{参拝|さんぱい}した。
examples.english: I visited Kyoto on a trip and worshipped at famous shrines and temples.

notes:
USAGE:
{参拝|さんぱい}する is used for both Shinto shrines (⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧) and Buddhist temples (⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧). It implies a respectful, purposeful visit for worship or prayer, not merely sightseeing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{参拝|さんぱい}する (to worship at a shrine)
- ⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{参拝|さんぱい}する (to visit a temple for worship)
- ⟦{参拝|さんぱい}→参拝：10634_sanpai⟧⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧ (worshippers, visitors)
- ⟦{参拝|さんぱい}{者|しゃ}→参拝者：21620_sanpaisha⟧ (worshippers)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦お{参|まい}り→お参り：16837_omairi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to visit a shrine/temple (casual, everyday)
- ⟦{礼拝|れいはい}→礼拝：16972_reihai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to worship (more formal, also used for Christian worship)
